one_line: A kiosk browser app on a Pixel Tablet: the camera watches the front path, an approach state machine builds suspense, a snapshot goes to Claude for a costume greeting, and a Piper neural voice with ffmpeg effects speaks it.
verdict: Not on the tablet: omxcode can draw every screen and run the visit logic on Linux and the web today, but it has no camera, no audio output, no text-to-speech, no kiosk controls and no https, and its Android host lacks timers and HTTP.

features.feature: Start screen: one big 'Wake Jack' button over everything (unlocks sound, camera, keep-awake)
features.evidence: docs/components.md rows Overlay, Card, Button (kit, workbook checks)

features.feature: Live camera view, rear or front, 'Switch camera'
features.evidence: no camera code in mojoui/ (grep getUserMedia/v4l2/camera: only video files via mojoui.video, mojoui.framefeed)
features.gap: mojoui.camera: live frames (V4L2/PipeWire on Linux, getUserMedia bridged by the web host, CameraX on Android, AVCaptureSession on Apple) into FrameFeed, so Canvas/Player show it and analyzers read it

features.feature: Tracking boxes drawn over the live picture
features.omx_piece: Canvas + mojoui.imageops (outline a rectangle) over mojoui.framefeed frames
features.evidence: docs/components.md rows ImageOps, FrameFeed (media, omxplorer checks); proven on video files only
features.gap: the drawing exists; it needs live frames from mojoui.camera

features.feature: Person detection on the device, ~10 times a second, box height as distance
features.omx_piece: mojoui.visionmodel (VisionModel DETECT, OWLv2 in process; SAM 2 tracking)
features.evidence: tests/test_visionmodel.mojo (docs/goals/39-check.py); CUDA + torch in process, stills and video files, not a live real-time loop
features.gap: a small real-time detector (EfficientDet/YOLO-nano class) compiled by MAX, running on the device's own GPU or NPU; today's model is a heavyweight desktop-CUDA one

features.feature: Approach state machine: idle → far → closer → door (held 600 ms) → linger ×2 → leave → re-arm
features.omx_piece: plain Mojo struct in update() + App.every() timers
features.evidence: docs/components.md row Timers; docs/ui-threads.md rule 5; a pure struct is testable with mojo test like tests/test_meter.mojo

features.feature: Rehearsal mode: a timer steps far → closer → door when there's no real door
features.evidence: docs/components.md rows Timers, Toggle

features.feature: Proximity meter with 'closer' and 'door' ticks, and the stage words
features.evidence: tests/test_meter.mojo; docs/components.md rows Meter, ProgressBar

features.feature: Jack the pumpkin (vector art) whose mouth moves while he talks
features.evidence: docs/components.md rows Scene: polygon fill, Canvas frames, Spring (sketch, omxplorer checks)
features.gap: no SVG paths or radial gradients in Painter: the art must be hand-ported to polygons; add Painter.path(svg d-string) + gradient fills

features.feature: Show mode: the whole screen is a big glowing Jack face, eyes blink, hold the face 1.5 s or tap Exit to leave
features.evidence: docs/components.md rows Overlay, Canvas: press, release, double, Timers
features.gap: works as a window-filling overlay; true fullscreen needs App.fullscreen() (see kiosk); glow art needs gradients

features.feature: Kiosk: fullscreen, screen kept awake, wake lock re-taken when the page comes back, camera restarts if it freezes
features.evidence: grep fullscreen/inhibit/wakelock in mojoui/: only a WebFrame permission string (mojoui/embed.mojo:22) and GTK reading 'fullscreened'
features.gap: App.fullscreen() and App.keep_awake(): gtk_window_fullscreen + idle inhibit (xdg portal), the web host's requestFullscreen + navigator.wakeLock, Android FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON + immersive mode, NSWindow/UIApplication idleTimerDisabled

features.feature: 'Jack said' card with the last line and a source badge (claude / fallback)
features.evidence: tests/test_chip.mojo; docs/components.md rows Card, Text

features.feature: Door-distance slider (20–85%), with 'right now' size and greeted-tonight count
features.evidence: docs/components.md row Slider (gallery, gpu, lens)

features.feature: Voice (Ryan/Alan/Joe/Northern) and strength (Spooky/Monster) pickers
features.evidence: docs/components.md row Segmented

features.feature: 'Jack listens' and 'Rehearsal' switches
features.evidence: docs/components.md row Toggle

features.feature: 'Greet now' test button
features.evidence: docs/components.md row Button

features.feature: Settings remembered per device (door, voice, effect, listen, rehearsal)
features.evidence: tests/test_omx_files.mojo; a settings file, not a typed key-value store; the web host keeps it per server, not per device
features.gap: mojoui.prefs: typed get/set per device (a file on desktop, localStorage on the web, SharedPreferences on Android, NSUserDefaults on Apple)

features.feature: Snapshot as JPEG → Claude vision → tease, greeting, answer, goodbye in one call; up to two banter calls; key kept off the screen
features.omx_piece: mojoui.http (Request.post_json, header_from_env, SSE streams) / mojoui.agui (Anthropic SDK via Python)
features.evidence: tests/test_http.mojo; mojoui/http.mojo:TLS_NEEDED (http:// only); docs/agui.md (Claude path, not run: no key)
features.gap: https to api.anthropic.com (a TLS transport: flare at Mojo 1.2, or a mojoui.llm client over Python interop like speech_torch), plus a JPEG encoder and base64 (only encode_png today)

features.feature: Canned fallbacks when the model fails or is slow, so kids always hear something
features.evidence: tests/test_http.mojo (failed replies arrive as events)

features.feature: Jack's voice: Piper neural voice, pitched down with a haunted echo (ffmpeg), rendered and cached per line
features.evidence: no TTS in mojoui/ (grep piper/tts/speechSynthesis: none)
features.gap: mojoui.voice: a TTS model in process (Piper ONNX via Python interop, like mojoui.speech; MAX later) + pitch/echo/low-pass as Mojo DSP kernels instead of an ffmpeg subprocess

features.feature: Playing audio out of the speaker, and the mouth following its loudness
features.evidence: mojoui/audio.mojo is capture only (pa_simple_read); no playback anywhere
features.gap: a Speaker beside Microphone in mojoui.audio: play(samples), level(), stop(); PulseAudio/PipeWire, Web Audio via the web host, AudioTrack, AVAudioEngine

features.feature: Haunted tune before the greeting (oscillators with vibrato)
features.evidence: no synthesis or playback in mojoui/
features.gap: a tiny tone/envelope generator in Mojo feeding the Speaker

features.feature: Fallback to the device's own voice when the laptop voice is down
features.evidence: no platform TTS binding
features.gap: platform TTS: speech-dispatcher, the browser's speechSynthesis, Android TextToSpeech, AVSpeechSynthesizer

features.feature: Kids talk back: listen after the greeting, a tiny vocabulary (hi, trick or treat, boo, thanks, bye, joke, who are you), ignore Jack's own echo, canned instant replies
features.omx_piece: mojoui.audio Microphone + mojoui.speech SpeechStream (whisper-large-v3-turbo on the GPU) + audio.best_match
features.evidence: tests/test_audio.mojo, tests/test_speech.mojo; Dictate probe (goal 43): 140 ms per clip
features.gap: Linux only today: the web host doesn't stream the browser's mic, Android has no mic and no Python; needs a mic on every host plus a small on-device speech model (whisper tiny/base via MAX)

features.feature: Status badges: camera, detector, ears (ok / warn / bad)
features.evidence: tests/test_chip.mojo

features.feature: omxqua night look: deep purple, pumpkin accent, kids' rounded type, roomy
features.evidence: themes/omxqua.mojo; docs/components.md row Themes on top

features.feature: Runs on the Pixel Tablet itself (Android)
features.evidence: docs/components.md Totals: Android 19 ✅ / 50 🔨 / 102 ❌; Timers, HTTP, Overlay, Meter, Chip are ❌ there; runs on the emulator only
features.gap: Android parity for what this app uses: Timers, HTTP, Overlay, Card, Canvas press/release, the chip and meter composites, then camera, mic and speaker

features.feature: Runs ~3 hours unattended without freezing (camera retry, model timeouts, no nagging)
features.evidence: docs/ui-threads.md (examples/jobwake, examples/slowcheck); no long soak with a live camera and models
features.gap: a 3-hour soak check once camera, detector and speaker exist

wins.what: Ears run whisper-large-v3-turbo in the app's own process on the GPU, offline: no audio sent to Google as Android's Web Speech API does, and Jack's echo can be rejected by matching his own samples (audio.best_match)
wins.evidence: docs/probes.md Dictate (goal 43): 140 ms vs 912 ms per clip against transformers.js; tests/test_speech.mojo, tests/test_audio.mojo. Linux only

wins.what: Open-vocabulary detection and tracking in process (OWLv2 + SAM 2): 'a child in a costume', boxes that follow each kid, not just the generic 'person' class
wins.evidence: tests/test_visionmodel.mojo (goal 39); unproven live, and too heavy for a tablet today

wins.what: One program, no laptop server: UI, state machine, detector, voice and the Claude call in one process; the key read from the environment by the HTTP worker, never in the app's state
wins.evidence: mojoui/http.mojo header_from_env; the one-process claim is unproven for this app (no camera, speaker or TTS yet)

wins.what: Agent-drivable for free: an agent could press Greet now, switch the voice, flip Rehearsal and read what Jack said, through MCP, with no extra code
wins.evidence: docs/agent.md (Slider, Segmented, Toggle, Button become tools; read returns texts)

wins.what: Voice effects as Mojo DSP instead of an ffmpeg subprocess per line
A freeze watchdog for the 3-hour run: any update, view or draw over budget is named

mojoui.audio Speaker: play(samples), level() (PulseAudio, Web Audio, AudioTrack, AVAudioEngine)
mojoui.voice: Piper in process + Mojo DSP effects; platform TTS as fallback

top_gaps.piece: Android Timers, HTTP, Overlay, composites, then camera/mic/speaker
a small detector compiled by MAX on the device GPU/NPU behind VisionModel
